links.comparator_used: Minimal prompting (basic-scoring instruction) versus detailed prompting with comprehensive TI-RADS guidelines, using GPT-4o
links.outcome: Accuracy of TI-RADS scoring (ACR TI-RADS points and K-TIRADS categories)
links.effect: ACR TI-RADS point accuracy rose from 50.3% to 78.5% (P < 0.001); Korean TI-RADS category accuracy rose from 58.4% to 79.9% (P < 0.001)
links.quote: ACR TI-RADS point accuracy increased from 50.3% with minimal prompting to 78.5% with detailed prompting (P < 0.001).

design_hint: detailed prompting with retrieval-augmented guideline grounding
